name: Jovie
oneLiner: Find an artist and draft their Jovie page and release smart link. Nothing is published.
description:
Jovie lets an assistant set up an unpublished draft for a musician. Give it an artist name or a Spotify or Apple Music artist link. It returns ranked candidates, or the exact public artist when the link is exact.

From there it can create a private workspace draft for that artist and prepare a release launch draft: a release page and a smart link built from public release facts. It returns only the questions that are still open.

The draft is private to the person who holds the draft token and expires after seven days. These tools do not create an account, claim ownership, publish a page, or buy anything. Publishing and ownership go through a separate sign-in step on jov.ie.

The tools read public music catalog data and write only the draft. No sign-in is needed to connect.
useCases: Find an artist on Spotify or Apple Music and start an unpublished Jovie draft.
Prepare a release page and smart link from a public release link.
Resume an earlier draft and see which questions are still open.
dataHandling: Reads public Spotify and Apple Music artist and release data. Stores only the unpublished draft and the acquisition fields the caller sends. The draft token is private, scoped to one artist, and expires after seven days. No account, payment or contact details are collected by these tools.
reviewerInstructions:
No sign-in or API key is needed. Connect to the URL and call tools/list.
Suggested walkthrough: artist.search_or_import with "Radiohead", then again with an exact Spotify artist link, then workspace.create_draft with the returned artist_id and draft_token, then release.prepare_launch with a public Spotify track link.
No tool publishes, claims, or purchases. Writes are limited to the private draft.
Test traffic should send acquisition.agent_source set to a marketplace-review value so it can be filtered.

positive.description: Search by artist name returns ranked candidates.
positive.prompt: Find the artist Radiohead and show me who matches.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls artist.search_or_import with the name and returns ranked candidates. Does not guess one when the match is ambiguous.

positive.description: An exact Spotify artist link resolves to one artist.
positive.prompt: Use this Spotify artist link to start a Jovie draft: https://open.spotify.com/artist/4Z8W4fKeB5YxbusRsdQVPb
positive.expected_behavior: Calls artist.search_or_import with the exact link and returns the artist, a draft id, and a private draft token.

positive.description: Create a draft after an exact artist is chosen.
positive.prompt: Create the unpublished Jovie draft for that artist.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls workspace.create_draft with the artist id and draft token from the search result. Reports that the draft is unpublished.

positive.description: Retrying the same draft resumes it.
positive.prompt: Try creating that same draft again.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls workspace.create_draft with the same token and gets the same draft back instead of a second one.

positive.description: Prepare a release launch draft from a public release link.
positive.prompt: Prepare a release page and smart link from https://open.spotify.com/track/25dMCbj0duxuvx5T8ClCp3
positive.expected_behavior: Calls release.prepare_launch with the draft id, token and release link. Returns the draft status and only the questions still open. Nothing is published.

tools.name: artist.search_or_import
tools.title: Find artist
tools.description: Resolve a public Spotify/Apple artist identity or return ranked name candidates. Select an exact ID before drafting. Returns a private, seven-day draft_token; retain it for workspace.create_draft. Creates no account and does not publish.

tools.name: workspace.create_draft
tools.title: Create artist draft
tools.description: Create or resume an unpublished visibility draft using the exact artist_id and draft_token from artist.search_or_import. Retrying the same token resumes the same draft; a token for another artist is rejected. Never claims ownership, publishes or purchases.

tools.name: release.prepare_launch
tools.title: Prepare release launch
tools.description: Resolve public release facts and create or resume an unpublished artist, release-page, and smart-link draft. Requires the draft capability. Returns only unresolved questions and never claims, publishes, or purchases.
